settings.custom_liquid:
<style>
/* =========================================
   PRODUCT DETAILS - READ MORE
   ========================================= */

.product-details-readmore-active {
  position: relative;
}

/* Collapsed content */
.product-details-readmore-active .product-details-readmore-content {
  max-height: 190px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}

/* Gradient fade */
.product-details-readmore-active .product-details-readmore-fade {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 42px;
  height: 85px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 2;

  background: linear-gradient(
    to bottom,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0),
    rgb(var(--color-background))
  );
}

/* Button */
.product-details-readmore-button {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 3;

  display: block;
  width: 100%;

  padding: 8px 0 0;
  margin: 0;

  border: 0;
  background: transparent;

  color: inherit;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.4;

  text-align: center;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* Expanded */
.product-details-readmore-active.is-expanded
.product-details-readmore-content {
  max-height: none;
  overflow: visible;
}

.product-details-readmore-active.is-expanded
.product-details-readmore-fade {
  display: none;
}

.product-details-readmore-active.is-expanded
.product-details-readmore-button {
  padding-top: 12px;
}


/* Mobile */
@media screen and (max-width: 749px) {
  .product-details-readmore-active
  .product-details-readmore-content {
    max-height: 190px;
  }
}
</style>
